name: Ravager already removes the minimum range of Ranger shots (#5479, #4038)
contract: Ravager 92116 (Ranger Level 10 Passive) grants SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_IGNORE_MIN_RANGE (312) misc 10 (IGNORE_MIN_RANGE_RANGED_ABILITIES). Quick Shot 500074 uses SpellRange 54 (5-30 yd, Flags 0, not SPELL_RANGE_RANGED) and DmgClass SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_RANGED with SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT set. Unit::GetSpellMinRangeForTarget (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp) already calls IgnoresSpellMinRange and returns 0 whenever it applies, before Spell::CheckRange branches on range_type, so min_range is already zero for every ignored spell regardless of its SpellRange Flags: the else-if branch's own `min_range > 0` guard already skips TOO_CLOSE. Without Ravager, Quick Shot at 2 yds (below its 5 yd minimum) must still fail SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE (128); with Ravager known, the same cast at the same distance must succeed (cast_failure 0), proving the contract already holds on current code.

steps.label: CONTRACT: Ravager removes the minimum range
